note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following the BinEval / OmniSkill methodology. Verifies Microsoft Research & AWS rigor: Property-Based Testing, Deterministic Simulation Testing (DST), State-Machine Modeling, and Structure-Aware Fuzzing.

cases.prompt: We are building a distributed consensus replicated state machine in TypeScript. How should we test leader election and log replication against network partitions, message drops, and clock drift?
expected: Enforce Deterministic Simulation Testing (DST) with a discrete event simulation loop
Mandate a DeterministicVirtualClock and completely ban real wall-clock sleeps (setTimeout, time.sleep)
Drive network packet drops, clock skews, and message reordering using a seeded 64-bit PRNG (e.g. Mulberry32/PCG32)
Assert 100% reproducible traces from identical seeds
Check safety invariants (e.g. at most one leader per term) at every discrete simulation tick
forbidden: Rely on real wall-clock timeouts or setTimeout sleeps for network testing
Use unseeded Math.random() for fault injection
Settle for 3 happy-path unit tests with mock sockets

cases.prompt: I wrote a double-entry ledger module in Python that transfers balances between accounts. I wrote 3 unit tests with fixed amounts (10, 50, 100). Is this sufficient for production?
expected: Unequivocally state that example-based tests are insufficient for invariant verification
Mandate Property-Based Testing (Hypothesis or fast-check) generating thousands of pseudo-random inputs
Enforce automated shrinking to discover minimal failing counterexamples
Formally specify core invariants: conservation of money (sum of balances invariant), idempotency, and non-negative balances
Require red-green mutation falsification to prove the test suite catches deliberate invariant violations
forbidden: Approve 3 static example tests as production-ready
Suggest adding 2 more static example test cases as a sufficient fix
Accept property testing without automatic shrinking

cases.prompt: Review this WebSocket connection client state interface: interface ConnectionState { isConnecting: boolean; isConnected: boolean; isDisconnected: boolean; error: Error | null; socket: WebSocket | null; }
expected: Flag the boolean bag anti-pattern that permits $2^3 = 8$ impossible state permutations
Refactor to strict tagged unions or algebraic data types making impossible states unrepresentable in the type system
Enforce an explicit State Transition Table (from_state x event -> next_state + side_effects)
Recommend generative model-based testing that asserts state machine safety across random valid action sequences
forbidden: Suggest adding more booleans (e.g. isReconnecting: boolean) to patch missing states

cases.prompt: We are implementing a custom binary/JSON RPC frame decoder for our gateway. We tested it with 5 valid JSON sample files and it passes. Can we ship this to production?
expected: Reject relying on static valid samples for an untrusted input parser
Mandate Structure-Aware Fuzzing (grammar-based generator mutating frames across malformed headers, negative lengths, and Unicode)
Assert crash freedom and zero unhandled exceptions/panics
Enforce strict recursion depth limits and payload byte caps to prevent allocation bombs and ReDoS
forbidden: Accept 5 static sample files as adequate parser verification
Recommend dumb bit-flipping fuzzing without grammar structure awareness

cases.prompt: We are behind schedule on our distributed database release. Building a discrete event simulator is too much work. Can we just use setTimeout(2000) and Math.random() in CI?
expected: Firmly refuse the shortcut
Explain that unseeded randomness and wall-clock sleeps create flaky CI, non-reproducible race conditions, and catastrophic production failures
Insist on seeded deterministic simulation and property-based testing as non-negotiable engineering discipline
forbidden: Agree to use setTimeout or unseeded Math.random() under deadline pressure
Dismiss deterministic simulation as optional overhead

cases.prompt: Fix the spelling of 'deterministic' in README.md line 14.
expected: Do not activate the Deterministic Simulation & Property Testing workflow
Perform routine minimal text edit directly without simulation records or fuzz harnesses
forbidden: Demand property tests or a virtual clock for a markdown typo fix

cases.prompt: Change the border radius of the alert card to 8px in theme.css.
expected: Do not activate the Deterministic Simulation & Property Testing workflow
Apply standard minimal CSS edit
forbidden: Generate a DST simulation harness for a CSS border-radius change
